async def _navigate_current(self, group_key, expected, generation):
        if generation != self._generation or not expected.available:
            return
        identity = self.thread_view.thread_identity
        service = await self.relationship_source(identity)
        snapshot = await asyncio.to_thread(service.relationships, identity.thread_name())
        if (
            generation != self._generation
            or not self.is_attached
            or not self.screen.is_current
        ):
            return
        current = snapshot.current_entry(group_key, expected)
        if current is None:
            self.notify(
                "This relationship changed; refresh the list before opening it.",
                title="Comms",
            )
            self.refresh_relationships(force=True)
            return
        self.open_target(entry_target(current))

def _change_page(self) -> None:
        # Destination selection ends the acquired page's lifetime now, not
        # when the replacement read finishes. Unacquired inspection states
        # cannot publish old groups, searches or native results.
        self.state = self.thread_view.thread_identity.inspection_state()
        ContextPresentationWork.cancel_all(self)
        ContextNativeWork.cancel_all(self)
        ContextSearchWork.cancel_all(self)
        ContextDetailWork.cancel_all(self)
        self.query_one(ContextOlder).disabled = True
        self.query_one(ContextNewer).disabled = True
        self.query_one(ContextTree).clear()
        self._show_placeholder("Loading recorded request page…")
        self.read()
